blocks.text: Umuman yoki aniq guruh: most people / most of the people

**all, most, some, any, no / none** ning ma'nosini qizil kitobdan bilasiz (→ qizil kitob, 81-dars). Bu darsning asosiy savoli — **of** qachon kerak. Qoida mantiqiy: **of siz** — gap **umuman** olganda, dunyodagi barcha shunday narsalar yoki odamlar haqida: **Most people** like holidays (Ko'pchilik dam olishni yaxshi ko'radi). **of bilan** — **aniq, ma'lum guruh** haqida, undan bir qism ajratilyapti: **Most of the people** at the meeting were tired (Yig'ilishdagi odamlarning ko'pchiligi charchagan edi). O'zbekchada ham shunday farq bor: «ko'pchilik odamlar» va «bu odamlar**ning** ko'pchilig**i**» — qaratqich kelishigi inglizcha **of the** ga to'g'ri keladi.

rows: **All (of) the** children in my class went home.
**Most of the** cafés here open at nine.
**None of the** hotels had a pool.

blocks.text: of qachon kerak va qachon tushib qoladi

**of** dan keyin doim **aniqlovchi so'z** keladi: **the, this / these, that / those, my / your / our ...** yoki olmosh. Shuning uchun «most of people», «some of students» — xato: yo **most people** (umuman), yo **most of the people** (aniq guruh). Ikki so'z — **all** va **half** — the / my / this oldidan of ni tushirib qoldirishi mumkin: **all the time** = all of the time, **half my salary** = half of my salary. most, some, any, none bilan esa of hech qachon tushmaydi.

items.text: **Most** shops in the UK close at six on Sundays.
items.translation: Buyuk Britaniyada **ko'pchilik** do'konlar yakshanba kunlari soat oltida yopiladi.

items.text: **Most of the** shops on our street are owned by one family.
items.translation: Bizning ko'chamizdagi do'konlarning **ko'pchiligi** bitta oilaga tegishli.

items.text: Bekzod spends **all (of) his** free time in the gym.
items.translation: Bekzod bo'sh vaqtining **hammasini** sport zalida o'tkazadi.

blocks.text: Olmosh bilan: all of us, none of them, most of it

Olmoshdan oldin **of** shart — hatto all va half bilan ham: **all of us**, **half of it** («all us», «half it» — xato). of dan keyin olmosh **to'ldiruvchi shaklida** keladi: **us, you, them, it** (we, they emas). **it** — sanalmaydigan yoki birlikdagi ot o'rnida: The pizza? We ate **most of it**. Ega bo'lganda **all of us** o'rniga ko'pincha **we all** ham aytiladi: **We all** agreed = **All of us** agreed.

items.text: **All of us** were tired after the long flight from London.
items.translation: Londondan uzoq parvozdan keyin **hammamiz** charchagan edik.

items.text: I've got three cousins, and **none of them** lives in Tashkent.
items.translation: Uchta amakivachcham bor, ularning **hech biri** Toshkentda yashamaydi.

items.text: Is there any soup left? — No, Jasur ate **all of it**.
items.translation: Sho'rva qoldimi? — Yo'q, Jasur **hammasini** ichib qo'ydi.

blocks.text: Fe'l **of dan keyingi otga** moslashadi, all / most / some ga emas. Ot sanalmaydigan yoki birlikda bo'lsa — fe'l birlikda: **All of the money was** stolen. **Most of the city is** flat. Ot ko'plikda bo'lsa — fe'l ko'plikda: **Most of the students are** from Fergana. **none of** + ko'plik bilan ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri (→ 86-dars). Britaniyada **staff, team, family** kabi jamlovchi otlardan keyin ko'plik fe'l ham keng tarqalgan: Most of the staff **are** on holiday.

rows: **All of it is** ready. **All of them are** here.

items.text: **Some of the advice** in that book **is** very old-fashioned.
items.translation: O'sha kitobdagi maslahatlarning **bir qismi** juda eskirgan.

items.text: **Most of the passengers were** asleep when the plane landed.
**Half of the work has** been done, so we can relax a little.
items.translation: Ishning **yarmi** bajarib **bo'lindi**, endi biroz dam olsak bo'ladi.

blocks.text: Ot oldin aytilgan yoki aniq bo'lsa, **most, some, any, none, half** otsiz ham ishlatiladi: Some of the guests left early, but **most** stayed. Yolg'iz **all** ega sifatida rasmiy eshitiladi (**All** are welcome — e'londa). So'zlashuvda uning o'rniga **everybody / everything** aytiladi — bu haqda 90-darsda (→ 90-dars). Ikki narsa haqida esa all emas, **both**, none emas, **neither** ishlatiladi (→ 89-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Most of people think ...» → **Most people** think ... (umuman) yoki **Most of the people** here think ... (aniq guruh); «The most people like summer» → **Most** people (the most — orttirma daraja, → 108-dars); «Some of they are late» → Some of **them**; «All of students passed» → **All the students** / **All of the students** passed; «Most of the money were lost» → **was** lost (money — sanalmaydigan).

O'zbekchaga qarab tekshiring: «...**ning** ko'pchiligi», «...**dan** ba'zilari», «...**ning** hammasi» deb tarjima qilsangiz — **of the / of my / of them** kerak. «Ko'pchilik ...», «Ba'zi ...», «Barcha ...» bo'lsa — of siz.

rows: all / most / some / any / no + ot

examples.title: In general: **most** people, **all** plants, **some** jobs
examples.description: Ot oldidan of yo'q — gap umuman olganda, dunyodagi barcha shunday narsalar yoki odamlar haqida: Most people like music.

sentences.text: **Most** people prefer to work from home at least one day a week.
sentences.translation: **Ko'pchilik** haftada kamida bir kun uydan ishlashni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: **All** passengers must show their passports at the gate.
sentences.translation: **Barcha** yo'lovchilar chiqish eshigida pasportlarini ko'rsatishi shart.

sentences.text: **Some** jobs are hard to do from home, for example nursing or teaching.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** ishlarni uydan bajarish qiyin, masalan, hamshiralik yoki o'qituvchilik.

sentences.text: Do **any** banks in Tashkent open on Sundays?
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **biror** bank yakshanba kunlari ishlaydimi?

sentences.text: **No** country can solve climate change on its own.
sentences.translation: **Hech bir** davlat iqlim o'zgarishini yolg'iz o'zi hal qila olmaydi.

sentences.text: In my experience, **most** children are crazy about dinosaurs at some point.
sentences.translation: Tajribamdan bilaman, **ko'pchilik** bolalar qachondir dinozavrlarga mukkasidan ketadi.

sentences.text: Not **all** students can afford to study abroad, so scholarships are important.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** talabaning ham chet elda o'qishga qurbi yetmaydi, shuning uchun grantlar muhim.

sentences.text: **All** plants need light and water to grow.
sentences.translation: **Barcha** o'simliklarga o'sish uchun yorug'lik va suv kerak.

sentences.text: Doctors say that **most** headaches are caused by stress or lack of sleep.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, bosh og'rig'ining **ko'p qismi** stress yoki uyqusizlikdan bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Some** people learn languages easily, while others need years of practice.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** odamlar tillarni oson o'rganadi, boshqalarga esa yillab mashq kerak.

examples.title: A specific group: **most of** the, **some of** my
examples.description: Aniq, ma'lum guruh haqida — of + the / my / these / our. O'zbekchada «...ning ko'pchiligi», «...dan ba'zilari».

sentences.text: **Most of** the people at the conference were from Asia.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyadagi odamlarning **ko'pchiligi** Osiyodan edi.

sentences.text: **Some of** my colleagues are learning Chinese for a new project.
sentences.translation: Hamkasblarimdan **ba'zilari** yangi loyiha uchun xitoy tilini o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Have you read **any of** these books about the Silk Road?
sentences.translation: Buyuk Ipak yo'li haqidagi bu kitoblarning **birortasini** o'qiganmisiz?

sentences.text: I spent **most of** my holiday in Samarkand with my grandparents.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilimning **ko'p qismini** Samarqandda bobom va buvim bilan o'tkazdim.

sentences.text: **None of** the shops near our flat sells fresh fish.
sentences.translation: Uyimiz yaqinidagi do'konlarning **hech birida** yangi baliq sotilmaydi.

sentences.text: Emma gave **some of** her old clothes to a charity shop.
sentences.translation: Emma eski kiyimlarining **bir qismini** xayriya do'koniga berdi.

sentences.text: Did **any of** your friends come to the airport to see you off?
sentences.translation: Do'stlaringizdan **birortasi** sizni kuzatgani aeroportga keldimi?

sentences.text: **Most of** the snow had melted by the time we reached the pass.
sentences.translation: Dovonga yetib borganimizda qorning **ko'p qismi** erib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: The teacher said that **some of** our essays were too short.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi insholarimizning **ba'zilari** juda qisqa ekanini aytdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod answered **most of** the questions in the interview, but he got stuck on **some of** the technical ones.
sentences.translation: Bekzod suhbatdagi savollarning **ko'pchiligiga** javob berdi, lekin texnik savollarning **ba'zilarida** qoqilib qoldi.

examples.title: General or specific? **most** / **most of the**
examples.description: Bir gapning o'zida ikkala shakl: umumiy fikr (of siz) va aniq guruh (of the / my bilan). «Most of people» — xato.

sentences.text: **Most** teenagers love social media, but **most of the** teenagers in my class prefer sport.
sentences.translation: **Ko'pchilik** o'smirlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni yaxshi ko'radi, lekin sinfimdagi o'smirlarning **ko'pchiligi** sportni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: **Some** hotels include breakfast, but **none of the** hotels on this street do.
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** mehmonxonalar narxga nonushtani qo'shadi, lekin bu ko'chadagi mehmonxonalarning **hech biri** qo'shmaydi.

sentences.text: **All** cars must have a safety check every year, and **all of our** company cars passed last week.
sentences.translation: **Barcha** mashinalar har yili texnik ko'rikdan o'tishi shart; kompaniyamiz mashinalarining **hammasi** o'tgan hafta o'tdi.

sentences.text: I like **most** kinds of fruit, but I didn't like **most of the** fruit at that market.
sentences.translation: Men mevalarning **ko'p** turini yaxshi ko'raman, lekin o'sha bozordagi mevalarning **ko'pchiligi** menga yoqmadi.

sentences.text: Are **any** museums free in London? — Yes, **most of the** big ones are.
sentences.translation: Londonda **biror** muzey bepulmi? — Ha, katta muzeylarning **ko'pchiligi** bepul.

sentences.text: **Most** tourists visit Bukhara in spring, but **most of the** tourists we met came in autumn.
sentences.translation: **Ko'pchilik** sayyohlar Buxoroga bahorda keladi, lekin biz uchratgan sayyohlarning **ko'pchiligi** kuzda kelgan ekan.

sentences.text: Not **all** medicines are safe for children, and **some of the** pills in this box are only for adults.
sentences.translation: **Hamma** dorilar ham bolalar uchun xavfsiz emas, bu qutidagi tabletkalarning **ba'zilari** faqat kattalar uchun.

sentences.text: **Some** people never read the instructions — **some of my** relatives, for example!
sentences.translation: **Ba'zi** odamlar ko'rsatmalarni hech qachon o'qimaydi — masalan, qarindoshlarimdan **ba'zilari**!

sentences.text: **No** smartphone is perfect, and **none of the** models in this shop has a good battery.
sentences.translation: **Hech bir** smartfon mukammal emas, bu do'kondagi modellarning **hech birining** batareyasi yaxshi emas.

sentences.text: Kate thinks **all** politicians are liars, but she admits that **some of the** local ones work hard.
sentences.translation: Keyt **barcha** siyosatchilarni yolg'onchi deb hisoblaydi, lekin mahalliy siyosatchilarning **ba'zilari** qattiq mehnat qilishini tan oladi.

examples.title: With pronouns: **all of us**, **none of them**, **most of it**
examples.description: Olmoshdan oldin of shart: all of us, some of them, most of it (we / they emas!). all va half ham olmoshdan oldin of siz kelmaydi.

sentences.text: **All of us** were shocked when the director announced his resignation.
sentences.translation: Direktor iste'foga chiqishini e'lon qilganda **hammamiz** hayratda qoldik.

sentences.text: I bought three melons at the bazaar, and **none of them** was ripe.
sentences.translation: Bozordan uchta qovun oldim, ularning **birortasi ham** pishmagan ekan.

sentences.text: The cake was delicious, and the children ate **most of it** in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tort juda mazali edi, bolalar uning **ko'p qismini** o'n daqiqada yeb qo'yishdi.

sentences.text: Have **any of you** been to Scotland before?
sentences.translation: **Birortangiz** ilgari Shotlandiyada bo'lganmisiz?

sentences.text: We invited twenty guests, but only **some of them** came.
sentences.translation: Yigirmata mehmon taklif qildik, lekin ulardan **faqat ba'zilari** keldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza wrote a long report, but her boss read **only half of it**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uzun hisobot yozdi, lekin boshlig'i uning **faqat yarmini** o'qidi.

sentences.text: **Most of us** take the metro to work, but Jasur cycles.
sentences.translation: **Ko'pchiligimiz** ishga metroda boramiz, Jasur esa velosipedda.

sentences.text: Those apples look old. Are **any of them** still good to eat?
sentences.translation: Bu olmalar eski ko'rinyapti. Ulardan **birortasi** hali yeyishga yaraydimi?

sentences.text: Thank you for the information — **some of it** was really useful.
sentences.translation: Ma'lumot uchun rahmat — uning **bir qismi** haqiqatan foydali bo'ldi.

sentences.text: There were six of us in the car, and **all of us** except the driver fell asleep.
sentences.translation: Mashinada olti kishi edik va haydovchidan boshqa **hammamiz** uxlab qoldik.

examples.title: **all (of) the**, **half (of) the**: dropping **of**
examples.description: all va half dan keyin the / my / this oldidan of tushib qolishi mumkin: all the time = all of the time. Olmoshdan oldin esa of shart. most, some, none bilan of tushmaydi.

sentences.text: **All the** students in our group passed the final exam.
sentences.translation: Guruhimizdagi talabalarning **hammasi** yakuniy imtihondan o'tdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar spent **half her** salary on a new laptop.
sentences.translation: Nilufar maoshining **yarmini** yangi noutbukka sarfladi.

sentences.text: **All of** the information you need is on our website.
sentences.translation: Sizga kerakli ma'lumotning **hammasi** saytimizda bor.

sentences.text: Why are you complaining **all the** time? — Because nothing works here!
sentences.translation: Nega **doim** shikoyat qilyapsan? — Chunki bu yerda hech narsa ishlamaydi!

sentences.text: **Half the** town lost electricity during the storm last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha bo'ron paytida shaharning **yarmida** tok o'chdi.

sentences.text: Oliver gave **all his** old books to the school library.
sentences.translation: Oliver eski kitoblarining **hammasini** maktab kutubxonasiga berdi.

sentences.text: **Half of** the guests left before the speeches, which was rather rude.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning **yarmi** tabriklardan oldin ketib qoldi, bu ancha qo'pollik edi.

sentences.text: I've waited **all my** life for a chance like this!
sentences.translation: **Butun umrim** bo'yi shunday imkoniyatni kutganman!

sentences.text: Sarah didn't finish the pizza: she ate **half of it** and kept the rest for lunch.
sentences.translation: Sara pitsani tugatmadi: uning **yarmini** yeb, qolganini tushlikka olib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: We can't use **all the** rooms in the new office yet, because **most of** them have no furniture.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisdagi xonalarning **hammasidan** hali foydalana olmaymiz, chunki **ko'pchiligida** mebel yo'q.

examples.title: Verb agreement: **most of the guests are** ...
examples.description: Fe'l of dan keyingi otga moslashadi: sanalmaydigan yoki birlikdagi ot — birlik fe'l (is, was, has), ko'plikdagi ot — ko'plik fe'l (are, were, have).

sentences.text: **All of the money was** spent on new equipment for the hospital.
sentences.translation: Pulning **hammasi** shifoxona uchun yangi uskunalarga **sarflandi**.

sentences.text: **Most of the guests were** relatives of the bride.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning **ko'pchiligi** kelinning qarindoshlari **edi**.

sentences.text: **Some of the furniture is** quite old, but it's still in good condition.
sentences.translation: Mebelning **bir qismi** ancha **eski**, lekin hali yaxshi holatda.

sentences.text: Look at this report — **most of the figures are** wrong!
sentences.translation: Bu hisobotga qarang — raqamlarning **ko'pchiligi noto'g'ri**!

sentences.text: **Half of the cake has** already gone, and the party hasn't even started.
sentences.translation: Tortning **yarmi** allaqachon **yeb bo'lingan**, ziyofat esa hali boshlanmagan ham.

sentences.text: Not **all of the news is** bad — the unemployment rate has fallen.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklarning **hammasi ham** yomon **emas** — ishsizlik darajasi pasaydi.

sentences.text: In my opinion, **most of the advice** on the internet **is** useless.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, internetdagi maslahatlarning **ko'pchiligi foydasiz**.

sentences.text: Are **all of the rooms** in this hotel non-smoking? — Yes, they **are**.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmonxonadagi xonalarning **hammasida** chekish taqiqlanganmi? — Ha, **shunday**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, **some of the luggage was** damaged on the way from Istanbul.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, yuklarning **bir qismi** Istanbuldan kelayotganda **shikastlandi**.

sentences.text: Because **most of the staff are** on holiday in August, the office closes for two weeks.
sentences.translation: Avgustda xodimlarning **ko'pchiligi** ta'tilda **bo'lgani** uchun ofis ikki haftaga yopiladi.

examples.title: Without a noun: **some** stayed, **most** left
examples.description: Ot oldin aytilgan bo'lsa, most, some, any, none, half otsiz ham keladi. Yolg'iz all ega sifatida rasmiy eshitiladi (All are welcome).

sentences.text: We had about forty applications, and **most** were from recent graduates.
sentences.translation: Qirqqa yaqin ariza oldik, ularning **ko'pchiligi** yaqinda o'qishni bitirganlardan edi.

sentences.text: I've tried lots of diets, but **none** worked for more than a month.
sentences.translation: Ko'p parhezlarni sinab ko'rdim, lekin **birortasi ham** bir oydan ortiq ish bermadi.

sentences.text: Some of the guests left at midnight, but **most** stayed until two.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarning ba'zilari yarim tunda ketdi, lekin **ko'pchiligi** soat ikkigacha qoldi.

sentences.text: Do you need envelopes? I've got **some** in my desk.
sentences.translation: Konvert kerakmi? Stolimda **bir nechtasi** bor.

sentences.text: The shop sells cheap umbrellas, but **most** break after a week.
sentences.translation: Do'konda arzon soyabonlar sotiladi, lekin **ko'pchiligi** bir haftada sinadi.

sentences.text: If you find old photos of the village, please send me **any** you have.
sentences.translation: Qishloqning eski suratlarini topsangiz, iltimos, **borini** menga yuboring.

sentences.text: **All** are welcome at the open day, and no tickets are needed.
sentences.translation: Ochiq eshiklar kuniga **hamma** taklif etiladi, chipta shart emas.

sentences.text: Some flats in the building have balconies, but **many** don't.
sentences.translation: Binodagi ba'zi kvartiralarda balkon bor, lekin **ko'pchiligida** yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina baked thirty samsas, and **half** were gone in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Madina o'ttizta somsa pishirdi, ularning **yarmi** o'n daqiqada tugadi.

sentences.text: There are several ways to get to Khiva, and **some** are much faster than others.
sentences.translation: Xivaga borishning bir nechta yo'li bor, ularning **ba'zilari** boshqalaridan ancha tezroq.

examples.title: Mixed: surveys, statistics and the news
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: umumiy va aniq guruh, olmosh bilan, fe'l moslashuvi — yangiliklar va statistika tilida.

sentences.text: According to a new study, **most** adults sleep less than seven hours a night.
sentences.translation: Yangi tadqiqotga ko'ra, kattalarning **ko'pchiligi** kechasi yetti soatdan kam uxlaydi.

sentences.text: **Half of** the people in the survey said that they couldn't live without their phones.
sentences.translation: So'rovnomada qatnashganlarning **yarmi** telefonsiz yashay olmasligini aytdi.

sentences.text: **None of** the candidates has a clear majority, so there will be a second round.
sentences.translation: Nomzodlarning **hech biri** aniq ko'pchilik ovozga ega emas, shuning uchun ikkinchi tur bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **All of** the flights to Manchester were cancelled because of the fog.
sentences.translation: Tuman tufayli Manchesterga reyslarning **hammasi** bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: The minister said that **some of** the new roads would open next year.
sentences.translation: Vazir yangi yo'llarning **bir qismi** kelasi yil ochilishini aytdi.

sentences.text: **Most of** the residents want more parks, but **few of them** actually use the existing ones.
sentences.translation: Aholining **ko'pchiligi** ko'proq bog' istaydi, lekin ularning **ozchiligi** mavjud bog'lardan haqiqatan foydalanadi.

sentences.text: The company says that **all of** its products are tested without animals.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya o'z mahsulotlarining **hammasi** hayvonlarda sinalmasligini aytadi.

sentences.text: Did **any of** the witnesses see the driver's face? — No, **none of them** did.
sentences.translation: Guvohlardan **birortasi** haydovchining yuzini ko'rdimi? — Yo'q, **hech biri** ko'rmadi.

sentences.text: Thanks to the new metro line, **most of** the city is now less than thirty minutes from the centre.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi tufayli shaharning **katta qismi** endi markazdan o'ttiz daqiqalik masofada.

sentences.text: We asked fifty shops about plastic bags, and **most of them** had already stopped using them.
sentences.translation: Ellikta do'kondan plastik paketlar haqida so'radik, ularning **ko'pchiligi** allaqachon ulardan voz kechgan ekan.
